01 / ABOUT ME

Engineering practical intelligence

I am an Informatics Engineering student at Universitas Muhammadiyah Sorong and a dedicated Cameraman & Videographer who unites computational problem-solving with compelling visual media.

Alongside machine learning, data intelligence, and full-stack software prototyping, I operate cameras for live documentation, institutional events, and creative video productions. My dual discipline ensures structured technical execution in code paired with keen visual composition, lighting, and narrative pacing behind the lens.
